title: Improvements in and relating to suction lifting equipment

features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.note: The reference describes a suction lifting apparatus but does not mention it being cordless, handheld, or battery-powered.

features.item: flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.quote: In a suction lifting apparatus the vacuum in the pads 3 is released by a valve 21 which opens in response to differential air pressure produced when the pads are disconnected from a vacuum reservoir 11.
features.note: The quote describes 'pads 3' which are the suction cups, implying a sealing mechanism to create a vacuum, consistent with a flexible sealing lip.
features.refuted: The quote describes the release mechanism of vacuum in the pads, not the flexible sealing lip bounding the sealed region against the workpiece.

features.quote: A micro-switch 31 actuated by the valve 21 ensures that a motor 10 runs continuously to maintain a vacuum when an article is being lifted.
features.note: The reference mentions a 'motor 10' to maintain a vacuum, implying a pump, but does not explicitly state it is electric, mounted within a rigid body, or draws air from a sealed region.
